verdict.rationale: Modal documents Sandboxes as long-lived containers with running commands, snapshots, logs, and filesystem/networking access (modal-docs-8,9,13,23), and community builders report using Sandboxes for continuously running GitHub Actions runners and agent runtimes (modal-comm-1, modal-comm-2), suggesting extended-duration viability. However, there is no explicit documentation of maximum sandbox lifetime, timeout configuration, or guarantees for multi-hour/day sessions. Missing for 10: explicit docs on max/adjustable sandbox timeout, first-party guidance or examples for hours/days-long agent sessions, and independent benchmarks confirming stability over long durations.
